_about: What Wireless RF Buddy shows from the bus: the radios already on the air near the plan. Tunables only: no code holds a device list. `kinds` is matched as in APKSoftapp.discovered (a case-insensitive substring of a protocol, scanner kind or device_class). `collections` are the topic segments things are filed under: PLUGIN.WIFI files this host's radios under wifi/Device/ and every access point it hears under wifi/Network/. `fields` names, in order of preference, the leaf a scanner publishes a radio's channel, frequency, band and SSID under. They are shown, never copied into the RF plan: a Wi-Fi channel is not a UHF carrier.
_measured: Bench broker 2026-11-04 (ROAD-3502), 40 s of APK.audio/System/Protocols/#: wifi/Device/wifi_dc_56_7b_2d_ac_c9 (device_class 'Wi-Fi Radio') and 81 wifi/Network/<bssid> (device_class 'Wi-Fi Access Point'), e.g. wifi/Network/wifi_0e_ac_8a_c1_81_7f/channel 157, …/frequency_mhz 5785, …/band '5 GHz', …/ssid BELL670. The leaf is frequency_mhz (not frequency / freq_mhz / freq). These detail leaves are not retained: they are restated every restate_s (30 s), so a radio's row fills on the next pass. 'wireless' is kept for the wireless-mic plugins (wireless_wwb, wireless_ias, wireless_soundbase, wireless_csv, wireless_pdf): all five are online on the bench but publish no Device/ tree yet, so nothing matches it today.
